Active.entry: processes ready, Active resource policy applied

Idle.entry: processes alive, Idle resource policy applied

Suspend.entry: Runner-confirmed process stop, data volumes still exist

Resuming.entry: credentials, capacity and disk checks passed, start in progress

Destroying.entry: delete accepted, verifying process and data resources one by one

Destroyed.entry: processes, first-version volumes and session secret confirmed removed

Lost.entry: Runner lease expired, actual process state unknown

refusals.when: state endpoint called with suspend_mode other than cold
create or resume requests more than the admission limits allow
resume from Suspend without valid credentials
refusals.notes: no operation is created and observed_state stays Suspend

refusals.when: expected_version mismatch or another change operation already pending
refusals.notes: error message tells the client to re-read state; never auto-overwrite

refusals.when: same Idempotency-Key replayed with a different body
refusals.notes: same key and same body returns the original operation

refusals.when: opposite-state operation requested while Suspending (replay of the same operation is allowed)
any change other than query while Resuming
state-changing action on Error before reconciliation confirms retryability
state-changing action on Lost before fencing/reconciliation
state or event submission from a stale generation (fencing token)
refusals.notes: runner/control-plane fencing rejection; late old-generation evidence only enters via verified reconciliation history

refusals.when: create with agent other than claude, or invalid resource/repo/tenant fields
operation type not defined for the current state
refusals.notes: refuse-on-unknown: never fall through to a transition or create an operation

inputs.milli_cpu: requested cpu_reserved in milliCPU against available host capacity
inputs.memory_bytes: requested memory_reserved in bytes against available host capacity
inputs.volume_bytes: requested volume_provisioned in bytes (workspace plus approved home) against available capacity

invariants.statement: No transition leaves Destroyed; repeating destroy returns the existing operation, it does not create a second one.
Lost retains the resource reservation; capacity returns only with confirmed stop/removal evidence, never automatically on lease expiry.
Lost never goes directly to Destroyed and never recreates the same sandbox directly (no double-start); fencing and reconciliation come first.

Every execution-instance replacement or cold resume allocates a new generation and a monotonically increasing fencing token; stale generations cannot submit state or events, and old-generation hooks cannot stop new tasks.
observed_state changes only on Runner-confirmed evidence; HTTP 202 is acceptance, not success; desired_state alone changes nothing.
At most one change operation per sandbox at a time; conflicting requests return 409.
Capacity and metering intervals close only on confirmed observation (runtime.stopped / resource.released), per the usage-ledger ADR; admission reservation and applied usage are recorded separately.
